name: Layout View
description: Play any level as a bare layout: gameplay objects only, in plain colours. Can also save a layout copy as a new level.

enabled.name: Layout view
enabled.description: Draw levels as a bare layout. You can also switch it from the <cg>LV</c> button in the pause menu, or with the keybind below.

toggle-key.name: Toggle keybind
toggle-key.description: Switches layout view on or off while you're in a level.

hide-no-touch.name: Hide No Touch and Passable objects
hide-no-touch.description: Also hide objects that can't hurt you or that you pass through, since they're decoration in practice. Applies to the layout copy too.

show-invisible.name: Show invisible gameplay objects
show-invisible.description: Draw every gameplay object fully opaque, even ones the level fades out or makes invisible with alpha.

hide-particles.name: Hide particles
hide-particles.description: Hide the particles around orbs, pads and portals. Particle objects are always hidden.

skip-shaders.name: Skip shader effects
skip-shaders.description: Draw the level without shader trigger effects (blur, glitch, colour shifts...). If a level with shaders looks wrong in layout view, turn this off.

object-colour.name: Object colour
object-colour.description: Main colour of every gameplay object.

detail-colour.name: Detail colour
detail-colour.description: Second colour of objects that have one.

hazard-colour.name: Hazard colour
hazard-colour.description: Main colour of spikes, saws and other hazards. Set it to something like red to make them stand out.

copy-drop-visual-triggers.name: Leave out visual triggers
copy-drop-visual-triggers.description: Leave colour, pulse, shake, gradient, shader, background/ground change and particle triggers out of the copy. Move, toggle, spawn and every other gameplay trigger are always kept.
